external_deps: A coding agent CLI (Claude Code, Grok, Codex or Opencode)

review.tagline: Pattern library and CLI for running scheduled agent loops around a codebase
review.summary: Loop Engineering is a library of documented patterns (daily triage, PR babysitter, CI sweeper, dependency sweeper, changelog drafter and others) for running coding agents on a schedule against a repo. An npm CLI (@cobusgreyling/loop) scaffolds a pattern for Claude, Grok, Codex or Opencode, then offers doctor, status, audit and cost commands. Rollout is staged from L1 report-only to L3 unattended.
review.audience: Teams running coding agents on a schedule against their own repos
strengths: CLI scaffolds a pattern with init, then checks it with doctor, audit and cost
Eight documented patterns, each with cadence, week-one level and relative cost
Staged L1 to L3 rollout; week one is report-only
Examples for Claude Code, Grok, Codex, Opencode, OpenClaw and GitHub Actions
weaknesses: Mostly docs and templates; the agent itself comes from a separate tool
PR Babysitter and CI Sweeper are rated high or very high cost
README warns unattended loops can ship mistakes and token costs can explode
Related features live in separate companion repos
needs: Needs Node.js (npx), GitHub, A coding agent CLI (Claude Code, Grok, Codex or Opencode)
Models: Claude Code, Grok, Codex, Opencode, OpenClaw
